products.name: Fast POS — High-Speed Point of Sale & Shift Accounting System
products.tagline: Lightning-Fast Billing, Table Tracking & Deep Financial Control for Retail & Restaurants.
products.summary: Fast POS is engineered for high-volume retail counters, supermarkets, bakeries, cafes, and family restaurants. Designed to eliminate checkout queues, prevent cashier leakage, and answer every critical financial question with complete audit trails.

screenshots.title: 7-Pillar Financial & Report Center

faqs.heading: Frequently Asked Questions About
faqs.subheading: Everything you need to know about pricing, hardware, installation, and multi-branch expansion.

items.question: Does Fast POS work when our internet is disconnected?
items.answer: Yes, absolutely! Fast POS is engineered with an offline-first architecture. All sales, barcode scanning, receipt printing, and cash drawer operations run locally at high speed without needing internet. Once your internet connection restores, all shift data and sales sync automatically with the cloud portal.

items.question: Can I manage multiple restaurant or retail branches from home or my phone?
items.answer: Yes! Our Cloud Multi-Branch & Franchise Management Portal allows owners and executives to log in from any smartphone, tablet, or laptop to view live sales, branch revenue rankings, stock levels, and staff shifts in real time from anywhere in the world.

items.question: What hardware do I need, and can you provide it in Lahore?
items.answer: Fast POS runs on any Windows PC, laptop, or touch terminal. It supports standard 58mm/80mm thermal receipt printers, USB/wireless barcode scanners, cash drawers, and digital weighing scales. If you already have hardware, we can configure our software on it. If you need hardware, our Lahore team can provide and set up complete packages.

items.question: How does the Central Call Center order dispatching work?
items.answer: Customers call your central business number. Your telephone agents enter the customer's phone and order details in the Cloud Portal. The system automatically identifies the customer's delivery area and routes the order directly to the nearest branch kitchen printer or screen with rider assignment.

items.question: Can we visit your office in Model Town, Lahore to see a live demo?
items.answer: Yes, we encourage it! You can visit our office on Model Town Link Road, Lahore, Monday through Saturday between 9:00 AM and 6:00 PM. We will demonstrate Fast POS on touch hardware and show you the live Cloud Portal. Please call or WhatsApp us at 0315-4112925 to schedule your time.

items.question: What training and ongoing support do you provide?
items.answer: We provide complete on-site and remote training for your cashiers, branch managers, and call center agents. Every license includes 60 days of complimentary priority technical warranty, and our Lahore team provides fast WhatsApp and on-site support if any issues arise.
